# UBC Unlimited — Utah Merchant Services

> UBC Unlimited is a Utah-based merchant services company providing credit card processing, POS systems, ACH/eCheck, and payment solutions to businesses across all 29 Utah counties and all 50 states. The company offers local, dedicated support with competitive interchange-plus pricing, fast onboarding, and specialized solutions for both standard and high-risk industries. No long-term contracts on most solutions. Phone: (801) 462-0923.

UBC Unlimited has 20+ years of merchant services experience. The team provides tailored payment processing solutions for every business type — from restaurants and retail to high-risk industries that standard processors decline. All pricing is transparent; free statement reviews are available to show businesses exactly where they can save.

Key differentiators: local Utah-based dedicated rep, interchange-plus pricing, same-day to 14-day onboarding depending on solution, high-risk merchant account expertise, and SkyTab/Clover POS authorized reseller.

## Payment Solutions

- [All Solutions](https://ubcunlimited.com/solutions): Full overview of payment processing solutions
- [Credit Card Processing](https://ubcunlimited.com/solutions/credit-card-processing): Interchange-plus pricing, Visa/Mastercard/Amex/Discover acceptance, next-day funding
- [Cash Discount & Dual Pricing](https://ubcunlimited.com/solutions/surcharge-cash-discount): Offset processing costs legally; dual pricing and cash discount programs
- [POS Systems](https://ubcunlimited.com/solutions/pos-systems): SkyTab and Clover POS systems; 14-day go-live target from approval
- [High-Risk Processing](https://ubcunlimited.com/solutions/high-risk-processing): Stable merchant accounts for industries declined by standard processors
- [ACH & eCheck Processing](https://ubcunlimited.com/solutions/ach-echeck-processing): Bank-to-bank transfers, lower fees than card processing, check guarantee
- [eCommerce Payments](https://ubcunlimited.com/solutions/ecommerce-payments): Payment gateways, hosted checkout, recurring billing for online stores
- [Mobile Processing](https://ubcunlimited.com/solutions/mobile-processing): Accept payments anywhere with mobile card readers and tap-to-pay
- [Virtual Terminals](https://ubcunlimited.com/solutions/virtual-terminals): Browser-based terminal for phone orders, mail orders, and manual entry
- [Invoicing](https://ubcunlimited.com/solutions/invoicing): Digital invoices with online payment links; no physical terminal required
- [Gift Cards & Loyalty](https://ubcunlimited.com/solutions/gift-loyalty): Custom-branded gift card programs and loyalty rewards to drive repeat business
- [Check Guarantee](https://ubcunlimited.com/solutions/check-guarantee): Accept paper checks with protection against returned or fraudulent checks
